requirements.title: Language and transport
requirements.requirement: Keep the service core in Mojo and the canonical hyfd interface as stdio RPC; no Rust rewrite or HTTP ingress is authorized.

requirements.title: Business authority
requirements.requirement: Keep authentication, durable business workflow, inventory, reservations, orders and notifications in owning application services; Hyf emits assessments without business mutations.
requirements.verification_method: architecture check, journey simulation and real-authority gate

requirements.title: Typed independent layers
requirements.requirement: Separate domain, application orchestration, provider adapter, runtime composition and transport; use explicit typed outcomes and no string-matched error control flow.

requirements.title: Spec-anchored scope
requirements.requirement: Implement the three approved operations incrementally against durable specs without unrelated deferred features or speculative framework work.

requirements.title: Compatibility
requirements.requirement: Preserve existing supported wire behavior, capability semantics and max_local compatibility; new operations are additive or explicitly versioned.
requirements.verification_method: existing canonical wire fixtures and compatibility tests

requirements.title: Repository authority
requirements.requirement: Use repo-owned forge-agnostic validation, preserve applicable AGENTS and parent release authority; no capsule-local .github workflows.
requirements.verification_method: policy check and documented command review

requirements.title: Product-level claims
requirements.requirement: Interpret multi-product updates as distinct evidence-backed claims rather than one global stock classification.

requirements.title: Claim status
requirements.requirement: Distinguish reported offers, forecasts, unavailable supply, corrections and unclear status; never promote a forecast to confirmed inventory.

requirements.title: Update operation semantics
requirements.requirement: Differentiate addition, remaining balance, replacement, withdrawal and correction with a scoped target or unresolved operation.

requirements.title: Unconfirmed quantities
requirements.requirement: Reported quantity is not automatically verified unreserved stock; preserve approximation and uncertainty.

requirements.title: Review and material clarification
requirements.requirement: Return reviewable proposed changes and material clarification targets; missing optional price does not block drafting while ambiguous withdrawal target blocks application.

requirements.title: Immutable clarification history
requirements.requirement: Treat correction and clarification as explicit revisioned new evidence; do not overwrite original text or rely on hidden memory.

requirements.title: Scoped withdrawal
requirements.requirement: Do not expand a product/listing withdrawal to unrelated farm stock; require sufficient authorized target evidence.

requirements.title: Unknown products
requirements.requirement: Unknown or unsupported product terms remain unresolved instead of forced nearest-catalogue assignments.

requirements.title: No publication side effect
requirements.requirement: farm_update.interpret returns proposals only; confirmation and version-checked idempotent application belong to the authority.
requirements.verification_method: architecture check and real-authority integration gate

requirements.title: Multiple demand lines
requirements.requirement: buyer_request.interpret preserves multiple products and demand lines with correct condition applicability.

requirements.title: Constraint strength
requirements.requirement: Differentiate mandatory requirements, preferences, explicit exclusions and permitted alternatives, including negation.

requirements.title: Missing is not a decision
requirements.requirement: Not-stated and contradictory conditions remain visible; missing substitution permission is not automatic permission or prohibition.

requirements.title: Typed matching input
requirements.requirement: buyer_request.match consumes the typed need and its revisions rather than reparsing rewritten query text.

requirements.title: Reviewable intent
requirements.requirement: Expose material unresolved fields and confirmations for the host without creating orders or hidden state.

requirements.title: Public surfaces
requirements.requirement: Provide farm_update.interpret, buyer_request.interpret and buyer_request.match with stable product semantics, not a generic Jev endpoint.
requirements.verification_method: API schema, discovery and process tests

requirements.title: Trusted source identity
requirements.requirement: Original text, actor/source IDs, revisions and timestamps come from trusted application context and cannot be generated or overridden by provider output.

requirements.title: Evidence integrity
requirements.requirement: Every interpreted field links to authorized evidence or declared deterministic derivation; validate exact source revisions and span-offset conventions.

requirements.title: Exact supported values
requirements.requirement: Use explicit bounded exact decimal/fixed arithmetic where needed; define overflow, precision and rounding, and keep unknown distinct from zero.

requirements.title: Unit and pack semantics
requirements.requirement: Normalize only compatible dimensions and trusted pack conversions; unknown pack size remains unresolved.

requirements.title: Approximation semantics
requirements.requirement: Preserve approximate wording without inventing numerical bounds or treating conversion precision as source precision.

requirements.title: Money semantics
requirements.requirement: Keep amount, currency, price basis, fees and minimum-order conditions distinct; missing price is unknown.

requirements.title: Source-anchored time
requirements.requirement: Resolve dates from source time and known zone/locale, preserve date-only/ambiguity semantics, and keep wall and monotonic time roles separate.

requirements.title: Freshness semantics
requirements.requirement: Separate record recency, harvest age, availability and verification time; one cannot stand in for another.

requirements.title: Version provenance
requirements.requirement: Record actual source/need/supply, schema, taxonomy, normalization, model, question and policy versions used.

requirements.title: Conflicts and revisions
requirements.requirement: Detect conflicting or stale records and preserve correction links rather than last-response-wins; external writes use expected versions.

requirements.title: Three-way checks
requirements.requirement: Each applicable mandatory check is pass, fail or unknown; any fail makes ineligible, otherwise unknown makes conditional, otherwise eligible.

requirements.title: Mandatory precedence
requirements.requirement: No semantic score or preference can override a failed mandatory condition; optional unstated preferences do not create blockers.

requirements.title: Snapshot scope
requirements.requirement: Evaluate only bounded authorized supplied records and identify exact revisions and coverage limitations.

requirements.title: Supported plan mode
requirements.requirement: Produce bounded single-supplier compatible-lot plans; label unsupported multi-supplier/planner modes rather than global unavailability.

requirements.title: Allocation conservation
requirements.requirement: Within a plan, allocations across all lines cannot exceed underlying lot stock; reject/resolve duplicate conflicting records.

requirements.title: Partial fulfillment policy
requirements.requirement: Shortage fails when partial fulfillment is disallowed; any partial plan requires explicit buyer permission and clear uncovered demand.

requirements.title: Alternative plan semantics
requirements.requirement: Alternative plans are not simultaneous commitments even if they reuse stock; output is never a reservation.

requirements.title: Evidence before scoring
requirements.requirement: Separate evidence sufficiency from suitability; do not use unknown as a score midpoint or promote uncertain mandatory premises silently.

requirements.title: Stable preference composition
requirements.requirement: Normalize rubric scores deliberately, compose versioned preferences and use stable deterministic tie-breaking without representing success probabilities.

requirements.title: No-market-claim overreach
requirements.requirement: No eligible result means none within supplied/evaluated scope; retrieval truncation and unsupported planning are explicit limitations.

requirements.title: Revalidate before commitment
requirements.requirement: Owning service must revalidate current inventory and reserve atomically under its transaction policy; Hyf does not implement that authority.

requirements.title: Dedicated provider adapter
requirements.requirement: Use a dedicated TypeSafe evaluation adapter rather than repointing max_local chat completions; keep provider wire types out of public business contracts.

requirements.title: Bounded interpretation
requirements.requirement: Use versioned bounded choices/propositions/scores; candidate discovery and value normalization remain explicit stages.

requirements.title: Correct question dependencies
requirements.requirement: Only batch independent questions against relevant shared state; dependent stages are separate and correlated outputs are not independent corroboration.

requirements.title: Strict answer contracts
requirements.requirement: Validate expected answer IDs/types, choices, finite values, probability distributions, rubric mapping and actual model version; fail safely on invalid responses.

requirements.title: Score range handling
requirements.requirement: Handle zero-indexed score levels and normalize by the actual rubric; Noul has no required confidence field.

requirements.title: Pinned evaluation configuration
requirements.requirement: Pin model/question/policy/taxonomy/schema versions and evaluate upgrades explicitly; never follow aliases silently in production.

requirements.title: Semantic not arithmetic authority
requirements.requirement: Keep arithmetic/date resolution/authorization and all business actions out of model judgments.

requirements.title: Safe provider failure
requirements.requirement: Interpretation failures remain unconfirmed/unresolved or explicit errors; only semantically safe labeled ranking fallback is allowed.

requirements.title: Provider request minimization
requirements.requirement: Send only authorized relevant content, with server-controlled instructions/model/configuration and bounded question/candidate/state sizes.

requirements.title: Live-model gate
requirements.requirement: Separate opt-in account smoke and real raw-input semantic evaluation from deterministic software correctness; use independent labels and controlled holdouts.
requirements.verification_method: evaluation harness and external release evidence

requirements.title: Persistent framing
requirements.requirement: Process multiple newline-delimited JSON requests until EOF, handle fragmentation/coalescing and flush responses without stdout diagnostics.

requirements.title: Recovery and limits
requirements.requirement: Recover after malformed frames when boundaries are known; bound input/depth/output and fail or close safely on unrecoverable framing.

requirements.title: Single in-flight request
requirements.requirement: Initially support one in-flight business request per process with host-owned bounded pooling; do not invent unnecessary multiplexing.

requirements.title: Shared deadline
requirements.requirement: All phases consume one server-capped remaining budget using monotonic elapsed time; host queuing does not reset it.

requirements.title: Bounded retries and circuits
requirements.requirement: Classify permanent/transient errors, bound retries/backoff/queues, avoid per-request health calls, and distinguish liveness from provider readiness.

requirements.title: Configuration and flags
requirements.requirement: Separate implementation support, provider configuration, permission, readiness and per-operation enablement; validate invalid combinations.

requirements.title: Cleanup and cancellation
requirements.requirement: Bound waits, close/reap resources and report local cancellation honestly without claiming remote computation or charges stopped.

requirements.title: Observability
requirements.requirement: Emit safe bounded reason/trace/version/degraded diagnostics; no secrets or unrestricted private text, no unbounded metric label cardinality.

requirements.title: Optional caching policy
requirements.requirement: Caching is optional; if introduced it is bounded, tenant/source/context/version keyed and invalidated safely; it never implies reservation.
requirements.verification_method: conditional cache tests or no-cache architecture evidence

requirements.title: Measured objectives
requirements.requirement: Freeze resource/SLO/cost/quality budgets from measured pilot evidence before launch; no fabricated numeric acceptance claims.
requirements.verification_method: load reports and owner release gate

requirements.title: Trusted host authorization
requirements.requirement: A consumer string or end-user tenant claim is not authentication; use the real host trust boundary and reject inconsistent/cross-scope context.

requirements.title: Source text is data
requirements.requirement: Source text cannot select endpoints, alter policy, fetch arbitrary URLs, invoke tools or elevate privileges.

requirements.title: External HTTPS
requirements.requirement: External Jev transport validates TLS certificates/hostnames and redirect credential policy; local test overrides cannot weaken production behavior.

requirements.title: Privacy and retention
requirements.requirement: Minimize provider payloads and evidence disclosure; respect host/provider approved retention instead of indefinite raw audit copies.
requirements.verification_method: privacy fixtures and account release gate

requirements.title: Secrets and configuration
requirements.requirement: Credentials/endpoints/model are server-controlled, sanitized in tests and never leaked in errors/logs or committed as real secrets.

requirements.title: Canonical fixtures
requirements.requirement: Version acceptance cases with requirements, fixed context, expectations, forbidden behavior and explicit synthetic/recorded provenance.

requirements.title: One shared authority
requirements.requirement: Preserve declared parent shared-wire authority with offline local mirror; keep Hyf-local test families separate.

requirements.title: Fixture validator integrity
requirements.requirement: Reject duplicate IDs, missing references/files, unknown assertion operators and empty expectations; test the validator negatively.

requirements.title: Hermetic local execution
requirements.requirement: After dependency provisioning, default build/tests require no external network, account, secrets, GPU, model server or parent checkout.

requirements.title: Production path coverage
requirements.requirement: Exercise actual domain/application/adapter/HTTP/stdio code using controlled external boundaries rather than a parallel fake service.

requirements.title: Strict scripted provider
requirements.requirement: Validate outbound request semantics and call counts/order; fail unmatched/unconsumed scripts and prohibit live fallback.
requirements.verification_method: harness negative and provider integration tests

requirements.title: Determinism controls
requirements.requirement: Control clocks/IDs/seeds/config/files/ports/scheduling and isolate cleanup; no sleep-based readiness or reserve-rebind races.

requirements.title: Independent oracles
requirements.requirement: Use reviewed expectations and independent small allocation oracles, not production self-comparison or model output as ground truth.

requirements.title: Properties and regressions
requirements.requirement: Test conservation/precedence/uncertainty/order/unit/revision properties with bounded seeds and saved minimal regressions.

requirements.title: Golden discipline
requirements.requirement: Exact business expectations include forbidden extras; tolerances are explicit and golden changes require requirement review.

requirements.title: Planned versus executed
requirements.requirement: Planned cases are not passed tests; activate each at its checkpoint and require all mandatory cases at completion without silent skips.

requirements.title: Repo-owned validation
requirements.requirement: Default pixi test remains familiar; add discovered repo-owned spec/domain/application/provider/journey/soak/live tasks incrementally and forge-agnostically.

requirements.title: Ordered commits
requirements.requirement: Follow the included sequence one independently tested/reviewed known-good commit at a time; evidence and document any proven necessary deviation.

requirements.title: Verification honesty
requirements.requirement: Record real commands/results and blocked/N/A checks; no source/model/production completion claims from package validation alone.

requirements.title: Tooling and quality
requirements.requirement: Preserve pinned tooling, discover actual format/lint/build/security checks and supported target matrices; Cargo applies only to real relevant Rust workspaces.

requirements.title: Real authority integration
requirements.requirement: Simulated handoffs do not establish actual persistence/idempotency/concurrency; test real owning services before production activation.

requirements.title: Model and account readiness
requirements.requirement: Real-model metrics and provider privacy/region/capacity approvals are independent release gates; keep thresholds predeclared.

requirements.title: Operational readiness
requirements.requirement: Exercise safe provider disablement/rollback without deleting accepted business records; supply runbooks, examples and measured resource evidence.
